introduction: United Way’s Rhode Island 211 service connects residents with local social services. Start with your location and immediate need.
description: United Way’s Rhode Island 211 service connects residents with local social services. Start with your location and immediate need.

sections.who: People seeking local resources can request referrals. Each provider has separate service and eligibility rules.
sections.get: The service supplies information and connections; it does not itself approve government benefits.
sections.docs:
• Your ZIP code or town.
  • A clear description of the need.
  • Any shutoff, housing or other urgent deadline.
sections.apply:
1. Contact 211

    Call 211 or use the help links at United Way Rhode Island.

  2. Describe the problem

    Explain the most urgent need and any access barriers.

  3. Follow referrals

    Ask providers about open intake and required evidence.
sections.after: If a referral cannot help, ask 211 about other local options. Keep provider names and contact details.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using United Way Rhode Island; Provider contact instructions. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Can it help locate social services?
